home.title: Household ledger

policy.title: Household sharing policy
policy.heading: How this record appears in the household ledger
policy.description: “Move to household” changes this personal record's sharing policy; it does not copy or move the source record. The original remains in your personal ledger.
policy.SHARED_COUNTEDDescription: Your partner can view it; it counts toward details, budgets, and charts
policy.SHARED_UNCOUNTEDDescription: Your partner can view it, but it does not affect budgets or charts
policy.PRIVATEDescription: Hide it from the household ledger and keep it in your personal ledger
policy.notOwned: Only the record creator can change its sharing policy
